question: A woman says, "This man's son's sister is my daughter." How is the woman related to the man?
solution:

Step-by-step Relationship Analysis:

Breakdown the statement: "This man's son's sister is my daughter."

 
• "This man's son's sister" – A son's sister is simply the man's **Daughter**.
 
• If the same girl is the daughter of the man AND the daughter of the woman, then the man and the woman must be the parents of that girl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/786665f8766673f819e5424cf0e0d85394d93b9f2422a185adc8c3c12d1fe992.png]
